types.semver.Version: Record {major: Int, minor: Int, patch: Int}

functions.name: text.casefold
functions.description: Lowercases for case-insensitive comparison, as Python str.casefold does.

functions.name: text.split
functions.description: Splits the first string at every occurrence of the second.

functions.name: text.join
functions.description: Joins the strings with the separator between each pair.

functions.name: text.chars
functions.description: Splits a string into one-character strings.

functions.name: text.starts-with?
functions.description: True when the first string starts with the second.

functions.name: text.ends-with?
functions.description: True when the first string ends with the second.

functions.name: text.contains?
functions.description: True when the second string occurs in the first.

functions.name: text.replace
functions.description: Replaces every occurrence of the second string with the third.

functions.name: text.to-int
functions.description: Reads a decimal Int, or none if the string is not one.

functions.name: semver.parse
functions.description: Reads MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, or none if the string is not exactly that.

functions.name: semver.compare
functions.description: -1, 0, or 1 as the first version is lower, equal, or higher.
